kb.title: Knowledge Base
kb.description: Verbatim backups of your Claude Code and Codex sessions, collected in the background.
kb.status.schedule.unsupported: Not supported on this platform yet
kb.sessions.empty: No sessions to show. Click “Collect now” to back up your history.
kb.sessions.deletedHint: The original file no longer exists; this is the backed-up copy.
kb.toast.syncProblems: Collection finished with {{count}} problem(s); see the log in the data directory
kb.error.loadFailed: Could not load the knowledge base: {{message}}
kb.sessions.messagesHint: Counts user and assistant messages only, not tool calls, so it is lower than the count in the viewer.
kb.version: AgentKB {{version}} (based on Claude Code History Viewer {{base}})
kb.action.syncDisabledDuringBackup: A backup to the external disk is running. You can collect again when it finishes.
kb.action.backupBusy: A collection or backup is already running.
kb.banner.configNewer: The configuration was written by a newer AgentKB (version {{version}}). Please update the app; the file was left untouched.
kb.banner.notSetUp: AgentKB is not set up yet. The setup wizard takes a few minutes.
kb.notice.scheduleRepaired: The scheduled task now points to this app: {{to}}
kb.notice.moveToApplications: AgentKB is running from a temporary location. Move it to /Applications so the scheduled collection keeps working.
kb.status.activity.backingUp: Backing up to the external disk ({{percent}}%)…
kb.status.backup.stale: {{name}} · no backup for {{days}} days — connect the backup disk.
kb.status.schedule.dead: The scheduled task is broken: it points to an app that no longer exists
kb.status.schedule.devNote: This is a development build; repairing points the task at it.
kb.filters.onlyDeleted: Only sessions whose source file was deleted
kb.sessions.emptyNoSetup: Nothing is backed up yet. Finish the setup first.
kb.sessions.limitNote: Showing the {{count}} most recent sessions. Use the filters to narrow down.
kb.toast.backupUpToDate: The external disk backup is up to date
kb.toast.backupSkipped: The backup disk is not connected; nothing was copied
kb.toast.repairFailed: Could not repair the scheduled task: {{message}}
kb.field.sourcesHint: Claude Code and Codex session folders found on this Mac. The originals are only ever read, never changed.
kb.field.dataDirHint: Where the backups and the index are kept. An existing AgentKB folder is used as it is.
kb.field.intervalHint: How often new sessions are copied in the background, even when this window is closed.
kb.field.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440.
kb.field.scheduleEnabled: Collect in the background (installs a login item)
kb.field.excludeHint: One absolute path per line. Sessions whose source path starts with one of these are not collected.
kb.field.excludeInvalid: Every path must be absolute (start with /).
kb.field.mirrorHint: A second copy on a USB or external drive. Network and cloud drives are not supported. Nothing is ever deleted from the backup.
kb.field.mirrorEnabled: Also copy the backups to an external disk
kb.field.noVolumes: No external disk found. Plug one in and refresh.
kb.field.mirrorFolderPlaceholder: Pick a disk above or choose a folder on it
kb.field.mirrorExisting: This folder already holds {{size}} of backups; they will be continued.
kb.test.dataDir.existing: Writable, {{free}} free. Existing data found: {{sessions}} sessions, {{size}} — it will be used as it is
kb.test.dataDir.notAbsolute: Enter a full path (starting with / or ~/)
kb.test.dataDir.notAFolder: That path is a file, not a folder
kb.test.dataDir.overlapsSource: This folder overlaps the source folder {{path}}
kb.test.dataDir.dbTooNew: This folder holds data written by a newer AgentKB; update the app first
kb.test.schedule.ok: Ready. The background task will run {{exe}}
kb.test.schedule.unsupported: Background collection is not supported on this system yet
kb.test.schedule.noLaunchctl: launchctl was not found, so a background task cannot be installed
kb.test.schedule.notWritable: The LaunchAgents folder is not writable
kb.test.schedule.devBuild: This is a development build, not an installed app. Its background task will not be set up automatically.
kb.test.schedule.translocated: AgentKB is running from a temporary copy. Drag it into /Applications and open it from there.
kb.test.schedule.diskImage: AgentKB is running from a disk image. Drag it into /Applications and open it from there.
kb.test.mirror.internal: This is a built-in disk. Only external disks are supported.
kb.test.mirror.network: This is a network drive. Only external disks are supported.
kb.test.mirror.cloud: This is a cloud folder. Only external disks are supported.
kb.settings.title: AgentKB settings
kb.settings.description: Changes apply to the next collection. The scheduled task is updated automatically.
kb.settings.scheduleNotUpdated: Settings saved, but the scheduled task could not be updated: {{message}}
kb.move.title: Move the data folder
kb.move.hint: Copies everything to the new place, checks every file byte for byte, and only then switches over. The old folder is kept.
kb.move.ready: Ready to move. Needs about {{needed}}, {{free}} free.
kb.move.resume: An earlier move was interrupted here; it will continue. Needs about {{needed}}, {{free}} free.
kb.move.existingData: This folder already holds AgentKB data. You can use it as it is (nothing is copied).
kb.move.problem.nested: The new folder must not be inside the current one, or the other way round
kb.move.problem.overlaps_source: The new folder must not overlap a source folder
kb.move.problem.not_a_folder: That path is a file, not a folder
kb.move.problem.not_empty: That folder is not empty and does not hold AgentKB data. Choose an empty folder.
kb.move.problem.not_enough_space: Not enough free space for the move
kb.move.done: Moved and verified. The old folder was kept: {{path}}
kb.move.failed: The move failed and nothing was switched: {{message}}
kb.move.scheduleFailed: Moved, but the scheduled task could not be updated: {{message}}
kb.wizard.title: Set up AgentKB
kb.wizard.description: A few quick steps. Nothing is saved until the very last one.
kb.wizard.welcome: AgentKB keeps verbatim backups of your Claude Code and Codex conversations. Here is what was found on this Mac:
kb.wizard.dataDirLocked: To move the data folder of a configured app, use “Move the data folder” in the settings.
kb.wizard.mirrorSkip: You can skip this and add an external disk later in the settings.
kb.wizard.confirmIntro: This is what will be set up:
kb.wizard.reuseExisting: Existing data ({{sessions}} sessions, {{size}}) will be used as it is.
kb.wizard.running: Collecting your sessions for the first time…
kb.wizard.failed: Setup did not finish and nothing was saved: {{message}}
kb.wizard.doneScheduleFailed: Your settings are saved, but background collection could not be installed: {{message}}
kb.wizard.doneBackup: The first backup to the external disk continues in the background; progress shows on the home page.
kb.search.placeholder: Search all conversations (Chinese, English, class names, error messages…)
kb.search.relaxed: no result has every word, showing partial matches
kb.search.noneHint: Try other words, or loosen the filters above.
kb.search.notReady: The search index is being built. It will be ready when the current collection finishes.
kb.search.noData: Nothing has been collected yet, so there is nothing to search.
kb.search.focusFailed: Opened the session, but could not locate the exact message.
kb.skill.title: Let agents search your history
kb.skill.hint: Installs a small skill so Claude Code and Codex can look things up here when you ask about earlier work. Nothing is installed unless you click.
kb.skill.state.foreign: A different skill with this name is there; left untouched
kb.skill.stale.missing_exe: the program it points to is gone
kb.skill.permissionNote: The first time Claude Code uses it, it asks once — choose “Always allow”.
kb.test.skill.ok: Found {{count}} session(s) in {{millis}} ms. An agent gets the same answer.
kb.wizard.agentsTitle: Let Claude Code and Codex search your history
kb.wizard.agentsIntro: Optional — you can also do this later in Settings.
kb.skillPrompt.stale: The agent skill needs updating: it was written by an older version or points to a program that moved.
kb.skillPrompt.offer: New: let Claude Code and Codex search this history for you.
